subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident remain a distinct Telegram/session-state tracker, or should maintainers split it across the existing DM-session, reconnect-drain, and compaction/loop trackers?
rationale: The evidence supports several overlapping root-cause families, but no single canonical issue owns both the two-chat session-state signal and the semantic irrelevant-output loop.

options.title: Keep Distinct For Maintainer Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer can decide whether one combined fix or several narrower trackers should own the incident.

options.title: Split Across Existing Trackers
options.body: Close or relabel only after copying the diagnostic evidence into the relevant open session-routing and Telegram delivery issues.

options.title: Treat As Config/Support Outcome
options.body: Document that unset `session.dmScope` caused shared DM context only if maintainers accept that this fully explains the incident.
